title: समकालीन साहित्यमा नेपाली लघुकथाको प्रभाव {Influence of Nepali Short Stories in Contemporary Literature}
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेखमा नेपाली साहित्यमा पछिल्लो चरणमा अत्यन्त लोकप्रिय रूपमा विकसित भइरहेको आख्यान साहित्यको एक लघुतम उपविधा लघुकथाको परिचयात्मक स्वरूपलाई सटिक सर्वेक्षण गरिएको छ । यसको साथै आख्यानका भेदहरूको तुलनात्मक सम्बन्धान्तरको चर्चा एवम् लघुकथाका विशेषताले पनि स्थान ओगटेको छ । लघुकथाको परिचय, आख्यानको विधागत सम्बन्ध र विशेषताकै सैद्धान्तिक पर्याधारमा नेपाली भाषाको समकालीन साहित्यमा नेपाली लघुकथाको प्रभाव, महत्त्व र थप सुधारका कार्यको सङ्केतलाई समेत सटिक रूपमा दर्साउने प्रयत्न गरिएको छ । प्रस्तुत लेखमा लेख्य विषयवस्तुलाई गुणात्मक विधिबाट प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ भने पुस्तकालय कार्यअन्तर्गत रही द्वितीयक अध्ययन सामग्रीहरू प्रयोग गरिएका छन् । {The article presented has developed a very popular form in the last phase of Nepali literature; the narrative of the story is a scientific survey of literature as an introductory form of short stories. With this, the difference of the narrative is that the comparative relationship is discussed and the specialty of the short story. Efforts have been made to introduce short stories, legislative relations to narratives and theoretical aspects of the theoretical basis of the specialty, including the impact of Nepali short stories in contemporary literature, the importance and the work of improving the story.}
american_english: This article conducts an apt survey of the introductory form of the short story, a smallest sub-genre of narrative literature that has developed in an extremely popular form in the last phase of Nepali literature. Along with this, the comparative relationship among the differences of narrative has been discussed, and the characteristics of the short story have also found place. An attempt has been made to aptly present the influence, importance, and indication of further improvement work of the Nepali short story in contemporary Nepali literature on the theoretical basis of the introduction of the short story, the generic relationship of narrative, and its characteristics. In this article, the subject matter has been presented through qualitative method, while secondary study materials have been used under library work.

australian_english: This article gives a solid rundown of the introductory form of the short story, the tiniest sub-genre of narrative literature that's become hugely popular in the latest phase of Nepali literature. At the same time, the comparative relationship between the different types of narrative has been discussed, and the features of the short story have also got a look in. An effort has been made to properly show the influence, importance, and pointers for further improvement of the Nepali short story in contemporary Nepali literature on the theoretical basis of the short story's introduction, the generic relationship of narrative, and its features. In this article, the subject matter has been presented through qualitative method, while secondary study materials have been used as part of library work.
informal_english: This article takes a proper gander at the short story, the smallest offshoot of narrative lit that's gone mega popular in the last phase of Nepali writing. At the same time, they had a good old natter about how the different bits of the narrative stack up, and what makes a short story tick. They gave it a proper once-over and tried to tell us how the Nepali short story is doing in today's Nepali lit, why it matters and where it could be better, all based on the theory behind the short story intro, narrative genres and their features. The subject matter's presented via a qualitative method, with secondary materials coming from library research.
